usefulness.rationale: The dossier correctly identifies Okonjo-Iweala and confirms her WTO Director-General role, but it rests almost entirely on a single PBS tag-page quote. It covers only three thin claims: her role, the circumstances of her appointment (Biden endorsement after Trump's block), and her vaccine-equity position. Nothing on her Nigerian finance ministry tenure, World Bank career, Gavi board chairmanship, or her broader WTO agenda. Each claim's citation does support its statement, so no overclaims were found; note the two unjustified conclusions in the reference data (Twitter board staleness, IDA donation) do not correspond to any dossier claim. The dossier does not explicitly acknowledge its own gaps. Too sparse to prepare for a substantive meeting.
